evidence.title: ConvergeFlow: Language Flow with Provable Convergence to Token Embeddings

summary: Researchers introduced ConvergeFlow, a flow‑based language model that mathematically guarantees convergence of its representations to the target token embeddings. The paper shows that this provable stability leads to more reliable training dynamics and competitive performance on standard NLP benchmarks.
title: New "ConvergeFlow" Model Guarantees Provable Convergence to Token Embeddings
